note: Pepin County publishes no general zoning ordinance or district layer; its land information plan says only shoreland zoning boundaries are in GIS. The county's ArcGIS services (gis.co.pepin.wi.us) hold only flood zones and sample data. The City of Durand's zoning districts exist only as a PDF map (2018), not a queryable service. The Zoning_Districts FeatureServer found on services.arcgis.com belongs to another jurisdiction (city-style codes, no Pepin attribution).
